text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Mejiro McQueen! It is Mejiro 
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The one to bring the glorious Shield home 
to the Mejiro family was McQueen! This is 
the one race she refused to surrender!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! I have pushed forward 
solely aiming for this very day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling my responsibility fills me with 
deep emotion. This is truly the dream I 
wanted to accomplish!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

Forgetting even to applaud, Mejiro Palmer 
could only stare in dazed wonder at Mejiro 
McQueen's dignified declaration of 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're amazing, McQueen...
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was an undisputed victory.
Yeah, that was an undisputed victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right? The results are amazing, but more 
than that, it's her attitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
To carry what you were born with and work 
hard to turn it into your own dream...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Just driving straight ahead. That right 
there is..."

Swallowing her next words, Mejiro Palmer's 
eyes clouded with a touch of loneliness.
That night—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, hey, what's wrong...? Need me 
to cheer you up?

That night, Mejiro Palmer looked gloomy 
the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, BFF, you know, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda light, you know...? And, 
well... it's small.

Mejiro Palmer looked up at the ceiling and 
let out a soft sigh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to be bound by the Mejiro 
name. I thought that and tried to just be 
myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how serious McQueen looked made me 
wonder... If she's not doing this for the 
Mejiros, who is it for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For my freedom. That's what I decided, 
but... Then what is that freedom for? Just 
plain selfishness? Or is there another 
reason?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't know for sure, but the reason is— 
Could I really be proud of this in front 
of McQueen? Could I stand alongside her? I 
just started wondering that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it was because it was the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)... Because it's a race so special 
to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to get myself back, even just a 
little... To do that, next, I need to...

Such a gloomy mood. What's best to liven 
things up is... a festival race, of 
course. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally running the Takarazuka 
Kinen!!!!!

The one who spoke up with a voice full of 
anguish was Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My bestie can run with way more fun! She's 
not done yet, she's gonna get super hyped, 
let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If it's a festival race where all the 
casuals can get totally hyped up! That's 
why...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right. If it's the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Sounds good. Let's go with that.

text_block_list.text: I give a small nod. And then—

"Let's take another look before the 
Takarazuka Kinen. At Mejiro Palmer's true 
feelings and passion for racing."
